For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three and request a like-for-like 12-month quote. Public pricing is mostly quote-based, so don’t treat any “total cost” below as a published tariff.

Provider	Indicative total cost*	What to verify
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Travel spend + negotiated service fee; possible 1.5% payment-gateway fee 
MakeMyTrip
	Service fee/booking, GST invoices, cancellation/change fees, 24×7 support, credit terms
Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel	Travel spend + quoted management/transaction fees	Dedicated account team, 24×7 SLA, offline booking fees, hotel/air markup, refunds, GST reconciliation
FCM Travel India	Travel spend + management/transaction fees	Implementation fee, transaction schedule, 24×7 support, policy controls, traveller tracking, international coverage

Why these: myBiz is simpler/self-serve; Thomas Cook offers a hybrid managed model with dedicated servicing and online tools; FCM is geared toward more structured corporate TMC programmes. 
mybiz.makemytrip.com
+2
thomascook.in
+2

*For budgeting, ask each vendor to quote all-in annual cost on the same assumed ₹50 lakh travel spend, including every booking, cancellation, amendment, implementation and support charge. That makes the comparison meaningful.

For a 50-person Indian company, these three are worth shortlisting:

Option	What differentiates it
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Best suited to SMEs wanting a quick rollout. Corporate fares, GST invoices, travel-policy controls, expense management, central wallet and 24/7 assistance. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1

EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	More travel-manager oriented: centralised employee bookings, policy controls, expense reporting, negotiated fares and 24/7 support. It says it serves 4,000+ businesses. 
EaseMyTrip

Thomas Cook India – Corporate Travel	More traditional managed-TMC model, combining travel experts with technology, self-booking, approval workflows, booking bots and backend reconciliation/accounting integration. 
Thomas Cook

Practical distinction: myBiz/EMTDesk are more self-serve platforms; Thomas Cook is more suitable if you want human travel-management support alongside the software.

Pricing: these providers generally quote corporate pricing rather than publishing a fixed ₹/employee fee, so request a 50-employee proposal with transaction fees, GST treatment, cancellation/change charges and 24/7 support SLA before comparing total cost.
